review_scope: Independent review of the exact metadata-only R2 binding for code/source identity, frozen evaluator package settings, truth/accounting contract, zero-debit scope, output isolation, resource bounds, and official registry lifecycle. No score/truth/label data rows read.

finding.title: Frozen evaluator imports package dependencies outside the bound dependency closure
finding.impact: The prepared binding authorizes/imports the same-package settings.py, but that file imports spike5.common and spike5.features and reads config/base_features.json and config/contract.json. The worker's allowed package origins contain only the seven executable_helpers, which omit common.py, features.py, and those configuration files. _load_evaluators therefore raises UNBOUND_FROZEN_PACKAGE_DEPENDENCY before saved-score evaluation can complete. The runner appends durable RUN_STARTED before invoking the monitored worker, so this can consume the new execution and end as CANNOT_CONFIRM.

exact_evidence.detail: The bound settings imports .common and .features and reads config/base_features.json and config/contract.json.
The required executable_helpers closure omits common.py, features.py, and their settings JSON dependencies.
The worker imports the bound settings and metrics, then rejects any spike5.* module whose origin is outside helpers.values(); run_saved_evaluation calls _load_evaluators.
The owner claims zero-debit RUN_STARTED and writes its durable start receipt before passing the worker to the monitor.

finding.reviewer_action: No run or evaluator smoke was attempted after this deterministic source-level blocker was established. No LOCAL_REVIEW.json was created.
